doc: Named-style deviation signatures (research/STYLE-VOCAB.md §2). A DESIGN-PLAN `style_licence` names a cluster here; `waives` enumerates the ONLY canon rules that licence relaxes — per-rule, never blanket, never a tier:invariant rule. `conflicts` flags canon the style collides with but may NEVER waive (it stays a hard failure); `canon_flag: true` means the style is banned as canon-negative regardless of licence.

brutalist.signature: radius 0; 1-2px asymmetric borders; dense <0.25 whitespace; flat high-contrast

neo-brutalist.signature: 2-4px+ black borders; hard offset zero-blur shadows; square corners; oversized display +1..+4 dev; saturated primaries

maximalist.signature: palette_size 8+; chroma variance up; many sizes/faces; tight <0.25; collage texture

editorial.signature: flush-left ragged-right; asymmetric grid; near-monochrome + one accent; display-led +4.3 dev

glassmorphism.signature: backdrop-filter blur + translucent + pastel; 12-24px radius; thin light border

neumorphism.signature: paired light+dark soft shadows; monochrome same-surface; radius large-soft; element-vs-bg deltaL <0.1 — contrast floor is NEVER waived

claymorphism.signature: >=16-24px pill; outer soft + inner light shadows; pastel

skeuomorphic.signature: realistic drop+inset shadows; bevel/inset edges; texture/noise

flat.signature: shadow count ~0; solid saturated blocks; zero gradient

corporate-Memphis.signature: flat vector illustration — banned as generic-stock tier (SOP-IMAGERY §6)

bento.signature: uniform soft-large radius; one accent tile per grid; dense tiles, uniform tight gaps

retro-Y2K.signature: candy multi-color gradients chroma_var >=800; multi-borders; metallic/bevel; condensed/mono display

luxury.signature: serif display; type-contrast high; airy >0.45; subtle Elegant motion; dark/neutral field one accent

playful.signature: pill >=20 + 9999; blobs/arches; saturated multi-hue; elastic overshoot motion

techy.signature: sharp P1 radius; 1px hairlines; mono display; dark field + neon accent

organic.signature: organic blobs (P4); earthy low-chroma warm; grain/texture; gentle ease-both

dark-noir.signature: mean luminance <0.2 field; thin display + bright accent; cinematic/B&W media
